Author: Jacob5800
Name: Retainer Pricer
Description: Price eligible retainer listings with live marketboard or Universalis data and a configurable match or one-gil-undercut rule. Manage retainer ventures using the game's own retainer UI.
Punchline: Price listings and manage retainer ventures.
Changelog:
## 0.5.1.101

- Added an optional Submarines tab (off by default; enable Show Submarines): at the voyage control panel it collects finished submersible voyages and redeploys them, and idle ones from their previous voyage log, on the same route. Parts at 0% are repaired first; without enough repair materials you are asked to skip that submersible or continue anyway.
